name: Open helm
description: A plain iron cap that leaves the face free to wince. Better than a hat.
notes: Light helmet at the top of the leather reference weight. Weight 1.25 kg (ADR-0003 reference weights). Catalogue tier common (economy doc, helmets light 35-60). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
